title: Thai Coconut Stew
description: A flavorful and comforting Thai coconut stew made with fermented ingredients and a variety of spices.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sweet potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the fermented Thai chili paste and Jamaican jerk seasoning. Cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
